intro: Grouped-query attention assigns multiple query heads to each key-value head. Correct head ordering matters even when all tensor dimensions appear compatible.
task: Implement grouped_attention(queries, keys, values). Different queries sharing the same keys can still produce different mixtures. Sharing a value head does not force the outputs of its query group to be identical.
requirements: queries is (Hq,Q,D), keys is (Hkv,K,D), values is (Hkv,K,V), all dimensions positive; Hq must be divisible by Hkv.
Query head h uses key/value head h//(Hq/Hkv). Compute stable softmax(queries[h]@keys[g].T/sqrt(D))@values[g].
Return (Hq,Q,V). This is unmasked attention over supplied projections, with no learned projection, causal masking or measured speed claim.

All numeric arrays contain finite real numbers with magnitude at most 1e30. Boolean arrays and boolean scalar parameters are invalid. Raise ValueError for invalid shapes, bounds or types. Do not mutate any input.

hints.title: Step 1
hints.body: Use contiguous groups rather than cycling through KV heads.

hints.title: Step 2
hints.body: Scale by the feature width D, not by the number of heads.
